author: first-hypotheses
statement: Conditional on the Merrill Investment Clock quadrant label being computable and active at the start of a holding month, that quadrant's declared equal-weight three-sector basket earns a positive 3-month forward cumulative total-return excess over SPY.
mechanism: Asset-class leadership rotates with the macro regime because the growth/inflation state drives policy and earnings: when growth and inflation both fall, easing policy pays bonds and defensives; when growth rises while inflation falls, equities lead; when both rise, real assets/commodities lead; when growth falls while inflation rises, cash and defensives outperform. The failure point is the mapping from the composite proxy to the true regime — any period where policy or an exogenous shock dominates (e.g. 2020-21) breaks the chain.
trigger_definition: Growth composite Z = 0.50*z(USALOLITONOSTSAM) + 0.20*z(INDPRO) + 0.15*z(-ICSA) + 0.15*z(-UNRATE). Inflation composite Z = 0.30*z(T5YIE) + 0.25*z(CPILFESL_YoY) + 0.20*z(PPIFIS_YoY) + 0.15*z(CPIAUCSL_MoM) + 0.10*z(TCU). Each input is transformed (level; YoY; MoM; sign-inverted where marked) and exponentially standardised with EWM span=24 monthly observations: z_t = (x_t - ewm_mean_t)/ewm_std_t. As-of rule: on the last calendar day of month m, take for every series its most recent observation available in the ALFRED point-in-time vintage as of that date (release lags honoured; no revised future values). Quadrant = (GrowthZ sign, InflationZ sign): (>0,>0)=Overheat, (>0,<0)=Recovery, (<0,<0)=Reflation, (<0,>0)=Stagflation. The label is actionable from the first trading day of month m+1 (entry at that close). Fixed sector mapping: Recovery={XLK,XLY,XLF}; Overheat={XLE,XLB,XLI}; Reflation={XLU,XLP,XLV}; Stagflation={XLP,XLV,XLU}. Best asset: Reflation=TLT, Recovery=SPY, Overheat=DBC, Stagflation=BIL. Forward window = 63 trading days from entry.
resolution_criteria: Data: FRED/ALFRED macro (point-in-time vintages) + Nasdaq daily ETF closes (total-return adjusted via the store's dividend yields). For every month from evaluation_window_start onward where a quadrant is active, compute the equal-weight buy-and-hold return of that quadrant's 3 sector ETFs minus SPY's return over the same 63 trading days. A quadrant is SUPPORTED iff mean excess > 0 AND one-sided t > 2.0 AND n >= 30 months. H1 is ADOPTED iff >= 3 of 4 quadrants are SUPPORTED; REJECTED iff <= 1 quadrant is SUPPORTED; otherwise NEEDS_STRENGTHENING. Secondary (reported, not decisive): the quadrant's best-asset ETF's absolute 3-month return rank vs the other three best-asset ETFs. No verdict is emitted below n=30 per quadrant.
data_requirements: FRED series: USALOLITONOSTSAM, INDPRO, ICSA, UNRATE, T5YIE, CPILFESL, PPIFIS, CPIAUCSL, TCU (scripts/check_merrill_clock_data.py)
ALFRED point-in-time vintages for the same series (release-lag-safe as-of values) — required to avoid revision look-ahead
Nasdaq daily closes: SPY benchmark + XLU/XLP/XLV/XLK/XLY/XLF/XLE/XLB/XLI + TLT/DBC/BIL

ALFRED point-in-time (PIT) vintages are MANDATORY for the revised macro series (INDPRO, CPIAUCSL/CPI, PPIFIS/PPI, TCU, UNRATE, ICSA): these are revised over time, so using latest-vintage values is revision look-ahead. Without PIT vintages this hypothesis must NOT be evaluated — the conclusion would be optimistic by construction.

search_grid_evidence: Conservative multiplicity N=8 = 4 quadrants x 2 statistics. (1) Statistics layer: the decisive test is the sector-basket excess return / t statistic evaluated across the 4 quadrants; a secondary statistic (best-asset rank) is also computed and printed even though resolution_criteria marks it 'reported, not decisive' -- because it remains visible in the output it could be selected on post hoc, so it is counted. (2) Frozen-mapping layer: the quadrant->sector and quadrant->asset mappings were fixed at registration time and are NOT choices made during the search, therefore they do NOT add multiplicity; N is deliberately NOT 4 x (#sectors) x (#assets). Ruling principle: multiplicity = the number of statistics that will actually be computed AND could be selected on after seeing results -- not the size of the design space.
